tips.text: Play the Tier 5 bounty on Void Flood or Void Cascade so that mission's normal rotation table also rolls.
Join a squad whose host meets the Mastery Rank lock if Tier 5 is locked for you.
Bring Titania to Void Flood; Razorwing grabs floating Vitoplast without parkour, and Rotation C takes about ten minutes solo.
Keep running the AABC loop instead of waiting for all-C; Zariman endless never turns into all-C.
Seal ruptures early, before a second one opens, so corruption never reaches 100%.
Agree on extraction with your squad before a Rotation C finishes; a few players waiting in the lift can pull everyone out.
Stay with your squad so Skittergirl does not steal your Vitoplast, and kill her to get it back.
Run Void Flood before Void Cascade; Flood drops two of the parts and Cascade only one.
Look for public squads on Cascade and Flood; players now run them for Narin gear too.
Most players farm Aeolak in two to three hours, and call it the easier Zariman weapon.
